fix(editor): read the levels below normal priority, leaving threads free
What this fixes
editor/extract.py port runs the launcher's Get the levels ready step (part of "Get levels and play"). It started one process per CPU thread at normal priority, so reading the levels took every thread and could leave the computer unresponsive until it finished. The build (tools/build_port.py) and the lighting bake (bake_all.py) already avoid this through openrac_common.background; the extract now does the…

pullRequests.title: fix(port): mask failing 2D pixels on a multisampled frame instead of discarding them
pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/aa-text-intel-arc
pullRequests.body: With anti-aliasing on, the menu text vanished on Intel Arc while the panels stayed. The text is the 2D path's only alpha-tested draw there, and its failing pixels used discard. On a multisampled frame those pixels now clear their sample mask instead, which writes the same nothing; a single-sample target still discards.

pullRequests.title: feat(frontend): smoother frame limiter (precise waits, front edge sync)
pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: feature/smoother-frame-limiter
pullRequests.body:
Before: the frame cap and the game's tick waited with a plain sleep, which wakes late by its own amount (about 0.1 ms on Linux, 1 ms or more on Windows). A capped frame was held by its start, so the time it reached the screen moved with its cost. With VSync off, frame times were uneven, around 1–2 ms of spread at 120–240 fps.
After: every wait (tick, cap, low-latency sleep, movies) ends within a few microseconds of its deadline. With VSync off, a cap above the tick rate and Low-latency frames…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): a landing with a full moby pool skips its missing actors
pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/nebula-g34-crash
pullRequests.body: The ship's landing (FlightUpdate) moves every actor of its scene each frame without checking for 0. When the moby pool was full the scene actor guard left an actor's slot empty, and the landing read through the null moby: Blarg Station crashed with the difficulty mod's extra enemies. While the update runs, the missing actors are now left out of its list and put back after it.

pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/pal-quartu-freeze
pullRequests.body:
Before: on PAL, flying from Kalebo to Quartu faded to a dim still picture and stayed there. The game had already autosaved, so after a restart you were on Quartu.
After: the flight loads Quartu.
How: PAL calls scale_game_frame_count through a cast, ((s32 (*)(s32))func_001F98C0)(12). hostgen sent that call through OPENRAC_CODE. No level copy was found, so the address stayed 0x1F98C0, and level 16's own function at that address ran instead. Its result made the fade wait about 1.4M frames. A cast…

* feat(port): a precise wait for the frame and tick deadlines

A plain sleep wakes late by its own amount (tens of microseconds on Linux
and Android, a millisecond or more on Windows), and every late wake is an
uneven frame. precise_wait::until sleeps to a learned margin before the
deadline (a high-resolution waitable timer on Windows, clock_nanosleep to
an absolute time on Linux and Android) and yields the rest. The movie's
